effectiveClaimDisposition.rule: Qualified claims are deliberate scope boundaries after publication-readiness review; they remain non-universal and do not authorize machine, mould, material, site or product-specific values/procedures.

qualityFindings.finding: Two historical review-ledger summary objects did not match their individual claim records.
qualityFindings.disposition: Individual claim records were treated as authoritative. Corrected recounts are recorded in book-claim-resolution-all-v1.json; historical ledgers are left immutable for audit traceability.

qualityFindings.finding: Qualified claims included both evidence gaps and deliberate scope boundaries.
qualityFindings.disposition: Forty-two evidence-gap qualifications were re-reviewed with stronger current evidence and promoted to supported. Twenty-one claims remain qualified intentionally because machine, mould, site, product-disposition or non-unique diagnostic boundaries are intrinsic to their wording. None of those 21 scope qualifications blocks generic Book publication review.

qualityFindings.finding: Clearing claim evidence gaps and conflicts does not itself authorize chapter publication.
qualityFindings.disposition: All chapters remain technical-review. No manifest/authored chapter is changed to verified by this audit; explicit publication authorization remains a separate governed event.

qualityFindings.finding: The original Book runtime enabled a verified listening control without a Book-specific handler, so read/listen parity was not technically enforceable.
qualityFindings.disposition: The Book runtime now renders verified Read and Listen surfaces through one governed verifiedChapterHtml renderer and delegates visible text to the existing device Read Aloud engine. qa_book_release_integration.py enforces that shared renderer/handler contract.

whyNotVerified: The accuracy gate forbids self-promotion from evidence review alone.
Explicit chapter-level publication authorization is not yet recorded by this audit.
Source currency must be re-confirmed at the promotion event for any source whose status could have changed.
Verified read/listen parity is implemented and enforced by release QA, but promotion still requires the current release head to pass that gate.

gateChecks.detail: 46 unique manifest chapters are covered exactly once across the five base claim-review ledgers.
137 globally unique claim IDs are present with section, class, applicability, exclusions, evidence, conclusion and basis.
All resolution evidence must resolve to a traceable HTTPS source record; qa_book_claim_coverage.py enforces this.
Ordered high-risk, all-book and qualification-review overlays produce 0 hold and 0 conflicting effective claims.
42 evidence-gap qualifications were upgraded with stronger evidence; the remaining 21 qualifications are explicit non-universal scope boundaries and none blocks generic publication review.
This audit adds no production setpoint, drying recipe, pressure threshold, vent dimension, cooling target, fill percentage or machine sizing factor to Book teaching text.
Troubleshooting conclusions remain hypotheses/evidence/tests rather than symptom-to-guaranteed-cause or guaranteed-fix rules.

Verified Read and Listen surfaces use the same governed verifiedChapterHtml renderer and Listen delegates that visible governed surface to the existing device Read Aloud engine; release QA asserts the contract.
0 chapters are promoted to verified by evidence-review or qualification-review overlays; fail-closed state is preserved.
